name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Provides income support of Rs.6000 per year to small and marginal farmer families across India in three equal installments.
benefits: Rs.6000 per year in 3 installments of Rs.2000
evidence_text: All landholding farmer families, having cultivable landholding in their names, are eligible to avail of the benefits under the scheme.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing Rs.5 lakh per family per year for hospitalization.
benefits: Rs.5 lakh per family per year for hospitalization
evidence_text: Households identified based on deprivation criteria in the SECC database, with annual family income up to Rs. 1,00,000, are entitled to coverage under the scheme.

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: Single-window portal for students to apply for various central and state government scholarships.
benefits: Scholarships ranging from Rs.1000 to Rs.20000 per year
evidence_text: Students belonging to SC/ST/OBC/Minority categories with family annual income not exceeding Rs. 2,50,000 are eligible to apply for scholarships under this scheme.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Guaranteed pension scheme for workers in the unorganized sector.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of Rs.1000 to Rs.5000 per month after age 60
evidence_text: Any citizen of India between the age of 18-40 years, having a savings bank account, can join the scheme.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Provides free LPG connections to women from below poverty line households to replace unclean cooking fuels.
benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove
evidence_text: Adult women belonging to a below poverty line (BPL) household, not already having an LPG connection in the household, are eligible for a free connection.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Life insurance scheme offering coverage of Rs.2 lakh at a very low premium of Rs.436 per year.
benefits: Rs.2 lakh life cover at Rs.436/year premium
evidence_text: Individuals aged between 18 and 50 years, having a savings bank account and giving consent for auto-debit, are eligible to join the scheme.

source.title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana Guidelines

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: Accident insurance scheme providing coverage for accidental death and disability at just Rs.20 per year.
benefits: Rs.2 lakh accidental death cover at Rs.20/year
evidence_text: Individuals aged between 18 and 70 years with a bank account are eligible to join, subject to auto-debit consent for premium payment.

source.title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana Guidelines

name: National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per year
evidence_text: Adult members of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work are entitled to apply for a job card and demand employment under the Act.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
description: Maternity benefit programme providing cash incentives to pregnant and lactating women for first live birth.
benefits: Rs.5000 cash incentive for first live birth in 3 installments
evidence_text: Pregnant and lactating women, aged 19 years and above, are eligible for cash incentive for their first live birth.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
description: Provides monthly pension to destitute elderly persons aged 60 years and above from below poverty line households.
benefits: Rs.200-500 per month pension for BPL elderly
evidence_text: Persons aged 60 years or above and belonging to a household living below the poverty line are entitled to a monthly pension under the scheme.

source.title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme Guidelines

name: Disability Pension Scheme
description: Monthly financial assistance to persons with disabilities from below poverty line households.
benefits: Rs.300-500 per month pension for disabled BPL persons
evidence_text: Persons with 80% or more disability, aged 18 years or above and belonging to a below poverty line household, are entitled to a monthly pension.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship
description: Scholarship for girl students pursuing technical education in AICTE approved institutions.
benefits: Rs.50000 per year scholarship for tuition and incidental charges
evidence_text: Girl students admitted to first year of a technical diploma or degree course in an AICTE approved institution, with family income not exceeding Rs. 8,00,000 per annum, are eligible.
